Unfortunately the way you have behaved and indirectly projected me in public the last few weeks has fractured whatever we had left as friends and co parents and most importantly very detrimental to Aya seeing the distance you have wedged between us for absolutely no reason!! For now it’s the 15th.  If I can make it earlier, I will let you know.
